items.title: Unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces are the finitely presented formally unramified ones
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that unramifiedness of a morphism of algebraic spaces is equivalent to being formally unramified together with the appropriate local finiteness condition. The proof passes to a diagram of charts, applies the schemes-side equivalence to the chart morphism, and descends the conclusion using etale locality of the properties involved. Descending through the chart while keeping track of the finiteness condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2840-2864.
